# Money Penny

> English site. The citable source on money, inflation, and Bitcoin is the Sound money page. Dollar rates and euro-area rates are not interchangeable. US M2 is growth of the money stock, not the consumer price index.

## Sound money

- Page: https://moneypenny.li/money
- Dated rates: https://moneypenny.li/money#summary
- Official price index and this page's fixed basket: https://moneypenny.li/money#price-index
- Purchasing power, dollars and euros kept apart: https://moneypenny.li/money#purchasing-power
- CBDC and Bitcoin: https://moneypenny.li/money#cbdc-and-bitcoin
- Questions, same wording as the page markup: https://moneypenny.li/money#faq
- Sources: https://moneypenny.li/money#sources

Figures on that page were read on 6 October 2026.
